reflectors.description:
What is "Aether Hellas"?

In Greek Mythology, Aether was the personification of the upper air breathed by the Gods. In early physics, it was believed to be the medium that fills the universe, allowing waves to propagate through space.

For us, Aether Hellas represents the "invisible web" that connects Greece to the world. It is our digital gateway that transforms the air into communication, bridging the distances between Rhodes, Thessaly, and Central Greece, uniting people and technology under a shared amateur radio vision.
reflectors.name: AETHER HELLAS P25 - 1005 REFLECTOR

Welcome to the [ALL IS WELCOME/50405] P25 Reflector!

This reflector is an open, friendly digital hub created to bridge operators across the globe. Powered by Project 25 digital audio, our goal is to provide clear, reliable communications and a welcoming space for technical discussion, ragchewing, and testing.

Whether you’re keying up through a local MMDVM hotspot or a full-power P25 repeater system, all licensed amateur radio operators are welcome to link in and join the conversation. Jump on, drop your callsign, and say hello!

With a Halo Halo Network, it celebrates diversity and connection, mixing voices and cultures like the famous Filipino dessert: colorful, layered, and always refreshing. Add in the XPR Pinoy spirit, and you get a reflector that’s proudly community‑driven, welcoming operators worldwide while keeping a strong Pinoy identity at its core.

In short: URF isn’t just about linking modes—it’s about linking people, networks, and cultures into one vibrant digital space.
